source: ENISA Space Threat Landscape 2025, Annex C Table 17 (via Phalanx/framework/enisa_threats_tuple.csv)
name: Data leaks
affected_asset_selectors: Ground: Production (Document Management, ERP software, Crypto hw/sw, Simulators, Soft/Hardware Test Tools)
description: Threat of potentially disclosing sensitive information to external third parties or skateholders who do not have the need and/or permission to view/access it. Leaked information can subsequently be abused for launching attacks on the entity the data originates from, as well as its partners, suppliers, etc. depending on the content of the data.
